title: Yang et al. 2025 — A multi-day and high-quality EEG dataset for motor imagery brain-computer interface
description: A multi-day, high-quality EEG dataset for motor imagery brain-computer interface research comprising 51 healthy subjects performing motor imagery tasks across three sessions on different days. The dataset includes two experimental conditions: a 2-class paradigm (left and right hand motor imagery) with 51 subjects, and a 3-class paradigm (left hand, right hand, and foot motor imagery) with 11 subjects. Data were acquired using 59 EEG channels sampled at 1000 Hz with standardized 10-05 electrode montage, totaling 39,600 trials with visual and auditory cues. This resource is designed to support the development and benchmarking of motor imagery BCI algorithms and classifiers.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuracle NeuSen W system with 59 Ag/AgCl electrodes in standard 10-05 montage at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Subjects performed motor imagery tasks (left hand, right hand, and foot) cued by visual and auditory stimuli with 1.5 s cue duration followed by 4.0 s imagery period. Three sessions were conducted on different days for each subject. Data were recorded in BDF format with 50 Hz line frequency and bandpass filtered at 0.5-40 Hz.
